title: Mosaic Woman with Crystal Orb
description: A woman with mosaic-tiled skin and hair styled in two buns holds a transparent blue orb containing a miniature landscape. She is surrounded by lush stylized plants, succulents, and floating blue spheres against a colorful geometric background.
prompt: A beautiful young woman with skin and hair composed of intricate mosaic tiles in shades of teal, turquoise and pink, her hair styled in two round buns with green leaves, gently holding a transparent blue crystal sphere that contains a tiny detailed landscape inside, surrounded by lush stylized succulents, ferns and flowers, floating blue orbs in the background, soft geometric mosaic patterns, dreamy ethereal atmosphere, vibrant yet soft color palette
